one_liner_zh: 直覺外科EPS大幅超預期18.67%、營收年增22.96%，達文西系統裝機強勁。
one_liner_en: Intuitive Surgical beat EPS by 18.67% with 22.96% revenue growth, on strong da Vinci system placements.
ai_view_zh: 訊號強勁正向：22.96%營收年增搭配近19%EPS超標，顯示達文西系統裝機與手術量雙雙加速，耗材經常性收入模式持續複利。短中期基本面動能突出，但50.63倍本益比代表市場已定價高成長，須持續以手術量與裝機支撐評價。中期關鍵在新平台採用與國際擴張。追蹤指標：達文西手術量年增、系統裝機數與裝機基礎、耗材營收佔比、毛利率，以及新一代平台採用進度與全年手術量指引。
ai_view_en: Signal is strongly positive: 22.96% revenue growth alongside a near-19% EPS beat shows both da Vinci placements and procedure volumes accelerating, with the recurring-consumable model compounding. Near to mid-term, fundamental momentum stands out, but a 50.63x P/E prices in high growth, requiring sustained procedure and placement strength to support the multiple. Mid-term, new-platform adoption and international expansion are key. Track: da Vinci procedure growth, system placements and installed base, consumable revenue mix, gross margin, and next-gen platform adoption plus full-year procedure-volume guidance.
highlights_zh: EPS 2.50美元，大幅超越預期2.11美元，正向驚喜18.67%
營收27.7億美元，年增22.96%動能強勁
達文西系統裝機與手術量成長推升耗材經常性收入
高轉換成本與裝機基礎構築深厚護城河
highlights_en: EPS of $2.50 strongly beat the $2.11 estimate, an 18.67% positive surprise
da Vinci placements and procedure growth lift recurring consumable revenue
High switching costs and installed base build a deep moat
risks_zh: 本益比50.63極高，估值對成長放緩高度敏感
醫院資本支出循環影響系統裝機節奏
手術機器人競爭者進入可能侵蝕長期市佔
risks_en: P/E of 50.63 is very high, highly sensitive to any growth slowdown
Hospital capex cycles affect system-placement cadence
New surgical-robot competitors could erode long-term share
